title: Unify Control-Plane Write Interfaces
intent: REST, MCP, and CLI long-running control-plane writes return canonical Nostr command receipts or use the normalized command publisher path.
observed_prework: web/src/lib/api/client.js has synchronous consumers for adoption scan/import and direct runtime actions.
ML REST writes already use Nostr command publishers and return 202 Accepted.
MCP deployment tools previously wrote deployment intents directly when invoked through bahia_deploy/bahia_rollback.
implemented_scope: Defined dto.CommandReceipt with request_event_id, status/result kinds, idempotency_key, status, relay count, timeout, error, and retry hint fields.
Added idempotency_key/status/error fields to service, LLM, and ML command publisher receipts.
Added default 30 second publish-and-wait timeout and deterministic idempotency key generation for signer-first operator client commands.
Added persistent d-tag replay lookup support in Nostr event repositories and reactor dedupe by kind/pubkey/d-tag.
Changed ML REST receipt response to the canonical CommandReceipt shape while preserving 202 behavior.
Changed MCP deployment/rollback to use ServiceCommandPublisher when configured, returning uniform receipts.
